nodes.text:
...

(She looks up, nods once, and goes back to the bellows. The bellows are not connected to anything.)

choices.label: What are you pumping air into?

nodes.text:
(She keeps working. After a while she speaks without stopping.)

"It went out with the forge. I was pumping then. I have not been told to stop."

choices.label: Who would tell you to stop?

nodes.text:
"The Legate."

(You wait. She does not add anything, and the rhythm of the bellows does not change.)
